description: Climate Change Field Guide for Northern Wisconsin Forests is a web tool or resource listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by Northern Institute of Applied Climate Science; The Nature Conservancy. Climate change is a growing concern for forests across Wisconsin. Foresters, land managers, and landowners are considering how to prepare for future conditions and how to evaluate risks for particular sites. Coverage: the United States, or as stated on the tool page. The toolkit lists hazards: Changing Seasons, Shifting Species, Habitats, and Ecosystems, Vector-Borne Disease, Wildfire. Assets: Economy, Forestry, Natural Areas and Wildlife. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the tool itself was not opened or run, its licence and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support climate-adaptation planning and exposure screening. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
